shorts.title: GTA 6: Map Colors Explained
shorts.description:
Pink with dark letters is the main story in GTA 6, dark with pink letters is optional, purple is a side task, and an hourglass means time limited.
Did you know this one? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts

shorts.title: GTA 6: How Long Is It, Really?
shorts.description:
Rockstar's Rob Nelson said his GTA 6 playthrough took about 80 hours, with optional missions. Guides put 100% well past 100 hours.
How far in are you? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts

shorts.title: GTA 6: Change Your Outfit Fast
shorts.description:
Cops know your outfit in GTA 6. Change at your safehouse wardrobe, some clothing stores and gyms, or save outfits to your car.
What's your go-to fit? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts
